newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK MYTILINEOS REVISES '96 SALES, PROFITS UPWARD.
newsitem.headline: GREEK MYTILINEOS REVISES '96 SALES, PROFITS UPWARD.

text.p: Greek metals trader Mytilineos said it revised its 1996 consolidated pretax earnings upward between 1.2 and 1.3 billion drachmas from an initial 963 million drachmas.
The management of the firm also told an extraordinary shareholders meeting last Friday that its 1996 consolidated turnover would exceed 25 billion drachmas, it said in a statement.
Exports already represent 40 percent of total sales with exports reaching 7.0 billion drachmas in the first-half of 1996, it said.
"Setting up a network of subsidiaries to administer its international investments in the Balkans, Middle East and Western Europe is among the short-term priorities of the firm," it said.
Mytilineos recently completed the construction of its merchandise distribution centre at Aspropyrgos, Attiki, it added.

The firm also recently acquired a majority stake in the construction firm Elemka SA which specialises in public and private works requiring a great deal of know how and the application of pioneering technologies, Mytilineos said.

Elemka SA which cooperates with well known foreign firms such as the Italian Alga, Cubela firms and the U.S National Seal Company is expected to post turnover and pretax profits that will exceed 700 million drachmas and 150 million respectively in 1996.

The extraordinary shareholders meeting last Friday approved the split of its outstanding shares to five new ones for two existing ones with the face value per share falling to 100 drachmas each from 250 drachmas currently, the statement said.
The new share capital of the firm will consist of 5,872,510 shares with a face value of 100 drachmas after issuing 3,523,506 new shares that will be given to shareholders free.
The new share will be given to the shareholders by end-November, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
